speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for Communications and Information (a) how many seniors did the SG Cyber Safe Seniors Programme reach out to last year; (b) whether there are any plans to expand this outreach target, especially to those who have not attended any similar programmes and do not live with younger family members; (c) if so, what are these plans; and (d) how does the programme ensure that seniors are continuously educated on the latest types of scams, given the evolving nature of scams.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: The programme reaches out to as many seniors as possible by working through various channels, such as pop-up events, webinars, as well as the SG Digital Community Hubs across Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: These hubs are conveniently located at community centres and public libraries, and seniors can walk-in to any of these hubs for one-on-one sessions with a Digital Ambassador.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: In addition to CSA’s SG Cyber Safe Seniors Programme, my Ministry also engages seniors on digital skills through other platforms, such as e-getai and dialect drama series, and IMDA’s SG Digital Office and NLB’s SURE programmes.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Through MCI’s surveys, such as the Digital Readiness Survey about to be released, we know that more can be done to improve the awareness and adoption of good cyber hygiene practices, such as the use of two-factor authentication and antivirus software.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will continue to engage our seniors to empower them to stay safe and secure online.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Are there plans to involve caregivers or family members of seniors for such programmes?

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Will MCI also rope in the Silver Generation Ambassadors for scam education as part of Silver Generation Office's (SGO) outreach into the community?

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: That is a method that we will continue to deploy.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: But he is also right that families, friends and caregivers of the seniors are another potential group that we can include, and I thank him for his suggestion.
